head_commit.message:
Codex bootstrap for #2 (#14)

* chore: bootstrap codex branch for #2

Opens the working branch so the keepalive loop has a PR to drive. No content change.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore(codex-keepalive): apply updates (PR #14)

* chore(codex-keepalive): apply updates (PR #14)

* Claude (keepalive) automated update for PR #14

* chore(keepalive): reset runner-dispatch debounce

The keepalive runner-dispatch debounce is keyed on (head_sha, provider). The prior
codex run on this head exited reporting success while its sandbox had actually failed
(bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR), so it recorded a completed dispatch with zero
tasks done. Every later dispatch then returned duplicate-completed, and the only thing
that clears that key is a new head commit -- which only the agent that is being refused
could produce. This content-identical commit breaks that deadlock.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* chore: drop generated build artifacts from the tree

Adversarial review flagged src/deliverable_render.egg-info/ as stray scope. Its
metadata still named stranske/Template rather than this repo, which is the kind of
stale fact a generated file carries in unnoticed. Gitignored so it cannot return.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* Implement deliverable render fixes and fallback features

* chore(autofix): formatting/lint

* chore(codex-autofix): apply updates (PR #14)

* fix(html): emit a usable file URI for Windows paths

urllib.parse.quote alone percent-encoded the backslashes and the drive colon, so
`C:\My Files\Doc.pdf` under a `file://{path}` template rendered as
`file://C%3A%5CMy%20Files%5CDoc.pdf`. A browser reads `C%3A...` there as the URL
authority, not as a local path, so the link does not open. The correct shape is
`file:///C:/My%20Files/Doc.pdf`.

_url_path() now normalises separators, gives a drive-letter path the leading slash that
makes the authority component empty, and keeps `/` and `:` unescaped. Relative paths keep
no leading slash, because document-system templates interpolate them into a base URL
where an absolute path would be wrong.

The old test built its expectation by calling the same quote() the renderer used, so it
would have passed for any quoting behaviour, including the broken one. The replacements
assert the literal URL, and one of them asserts `C%3A` and `%5C` are absent so the defect
cannot return quietly.

Deliberate-break gate: restoring the naive quote() fails
test_windows_path_renders_a_usable_file_uri; restoring the fix passes all 49.

Found by adversarial review of this PR.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(packaging): replace the template author and repository URLs

CodeRabbit raised this against src/deliverable_render.egg-info/, which I had already
deleted as a build artifact. Deleting the generated copy removed the symptom, not the
cause: pyproject.toml itself still declared `Your Name`, `your.email@example.com`, and
`https://github.com/stranske/Template` for both Homepage and Repository.

Those values are built into the sdist and wheel, so an installer reads the placeholder as
this package's author of record and is pointed at a different repository entirely.

Guards folded into tests/test_package_identity.py rather than a new file, since that
module already exists to catch exactly this class of leftover-template defect.

Deliberate-break gate: restoring the placeholder author fails
test_authors_are_not_template_placeholders; reverting passes all 51.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
